paragraphs.en: Preparation of the metastable crystal modification II
paragraphs.notes: Underlined section heading, printed on its own line above [0056]. It carries no paragraph marker of its own, so the marker field is the empty string rather than null: build_enriched.py emits '{marker} {zh}' and a null marker would print the word 'None' into the enriched document.

paragraphs.zh: 2 g Tembotrione wurden in der Siedehitze (78°C) vollständig in Ethanol gelöst. Die klare Lösung wurde dann langsam, d.h. mit einer Kühlrate kleiner 20°C/h bis auf 7°C abgekühlt. Das Kristallisat wird abfiltriert und bei Temperaturen < 60°C getrocknet.
paragraphs.en: 2 g of tembotrione were dissolved completely in ethanol at the boil (78°C). The clear solution was then cooled slowly, i.e. at a cooling rate of less than 20°C/h, down to 7°C. The crystallisate is filtered off and dried at temperatures < 60°C.
paragraphs.notes: Worked example for modification II. Every quantity transcribed as printed: 2 g, 78°C, 20°C/h, 7°C, < 60°C. The degree sign and the 'C' are printed as '°C' with no space, and '< 60°C' is printed with a space after the less-than sign; both are kept as printed. The tense shift in the German (past 'wurden ... gelöst ... abgekühlt', then present 'wird abfiltriert ... getrocknet') is as printed and is not normalised. No line-break hyphens fell inside a word in this paragraph. This paragraph belongs to the description, not to the claims, even though the page as a whole is labelled doc_part 'claims'.

paragraphs.en: Preparation of the metastable crystal modification III
paragraphs.notes: Underlined section heading printed on its own line above [0057]. Empty marker for the same reason as the heading above [0056].

paragraphs.zh: 2 g Tembotrione wurden in der Siedehitze (111°C) vollständig in Toluol gelöst. Die klare Lösung wurde dann langsam, d.h. mit einer Kühlrate kleiner 20°C/h bis auf 7°C abgekühlt. Das Kristallisat wird abfiltriert und bei Temperaturen < 60°C getrocknet.
paragraphs.en: 2 g of tembotrione were dissolved completely in toluene at the boil (111°C). The clear solution was then cooled slowly, i.e. at a cooling rate of less than 20°C/h, down to 7°C. The crystallisate is filtered off and dried at temperatures < 60°C.
paragraphs.notes: Worked example for modification III. Word for word identical to [0056] apart from the solvent and its boiling temperature: 'Toluol' at 111°C here against 'Ethanol' at 78°C there. The cooling rate (< 20°C/h), the final temperature (7°C), the charge (2 g) and the drying temperature (< 60°C) are the same in both. Belongs to the description, not to the claims.
Underlined section heading printed on its own line above [0058]. Empty marker for the same reason as the headings above.

paragraphs.zh: Eine Öldispersion von Tembotrione der Kristallmodifikation I zeigt im Vergleich zu einer Öldispersion von Tembotrione der Kristallmodifikation II, III oder einem Gemisch davon, auch nach mehreren Wochen Lagerung keine Anzeichen von Ausklumpen und Ausfällungen.
paragraphs.en: An oil dispersion of tembotrione of crystal modification I shows, by comparison with an oil dispersion of tembotrione of crystal modification II, III or a mixture thereof, no signs of clumping or precipitation even after several weeks of storage.
paragraphs.notes: No quantity, no duration and no temperature is given: the storage period is stated only as 'mehreren Wochen' (several weeks) and no oil, no concentration and no test protocol is named. The German sentence is structurally ambiguous about which dispersion is the one that stays clean. Read literally, the subject is the modification I dispersion and it is the one showing no clumping or precipitation, with the II/III dispersion as the comparator; that literal reading is the one translated here. The alternative reading, in which 'keine Anzeichen' is asserted of both, is not excluded by the German. Flagged rather than resolved. Belongs to the description, not to the claims. Last numbered paragraph of the description; the description ends here and the claims begin on this same page.
Bold section heading, printed on its own line. The claims of EP 2 045 236 A1 begin here, part way down page 12.

paragraphs.zh: Kristallmodifikation von 2-({2-Chlor-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluorethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexan-1,3-dion (Tembotrione) in einem orthorhombischen System.
paragraphs.en: Crystal modification of 2-({2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]phenyl}carbonyl)cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione) in an orthorhombic system.
paragraphs.notes: Independent claim. The marker is the printed claim number '1.'; claims carry no [00NN] marker. The name breaks across a line at 'cyclohexan-' / '1,3-dion'; that hyphen is REAL, it is part of the chemical name 'cyclohexan-1,3-dion', and it was kept rather than repaired away. The nesting of the brackets is transcribed exactly as printed, round-brace-open then curly-brace-open, and the closing curly brace before 'carbonyl'. No structural formula is drawn anywhere on this page; the compound appears only as this name.

paragraphs.zh: Kristallmodifikation nach Anspruch 1, wobei das orthorhombische System die Raumgruppe Pna21 aufweist.
paragraphs.en: Crystal modification according to claim 1, wherein the orthorhombic system has the space group Pna21.
paragraphs.notes: The space group is printed as an italic capital P, then 'na2' upright, then a SUBSCRIPT 1: Pna2 with subscript one, the standard Hermann-Mauguin setting Pna2(1). Italics and subscript cannot be represented here, so it is recorded flat as 'Pna21', matching the text layer. A downstream reader must not read the final '1' as part of the digit string '21'.

INFRARED spectrum. 37 values in total, in 4 columns of 10 rows; column 4 holds only 7 values, so the last three cells of column 4 are empty on the page. Empty cells are a column that has run out, not missing data, and are recorded as empty markdown cells. Column 1: 593 to 853 (10 values). Column 2: 883 to 1164 (10). Column 3: 1196 to 1461 (10). Column 4: 1553 to 3075 (7). Read column-major the 37 values ascend strictly, which is the check that the column-major reading is the right one. COLUMN STRUCTURE, read off the page image, not off the text layer: the list is printed inside a single ruled box as FOUR columns of bare numbers, with a vertical rule between column 2 and column 3 and no other internal rules, no header row and no caption. Reading order is column-major: down column 1, then down column 2, then column 3, then column 4, which is the order in which the values ascend monotonically. The extracted text layer flattens the box ROW-major ("593 883 1196 1553 612 921 ..."), which is not the ascending series and would misrepresent the claim; the digits were confirmed against the text layer but the layout comes from the image. Markdown needs a header row and the page prints none, so the 'Spalte N' / 'Column N' header here is editorial and is not printed on the page. 'Bandenma-xima' is broken across a line break in the two-column setting and was reassembled to 'Bandenmaxima'. The hyphen in 'Infrarot-Spektrum' is real and was kept. The unit is printed as 'cm' with a superscript minus one and is recorded as 'cm-1' per the briefing. This list DIFFERS from the list under claim 4; see the page notes.

notes: Page 12 of EP 2 045 236 A1. It carries the end of the description and the start of the claims, which is why doc_part is set to 'claims': the enum has no mixed value and the claims are the bulk of the page. Paragraphs [0056], [0057] and [0058] at the top of the page are DESCRIPTION, not claims, and each says so in its own notes. CONTENT: three underlined section headings with their numbered paragraphs ([0056] preparation of metastable modification II, [0057] preparation of metastable modification III, [0058] stability trials), then the bold heading 'Patentansprüche' and claims 1 to 4. Four claims are captured in full. Claim 4 is not the last claim of the patent; the claims continue on page 13. SAME OR DIFFERENT: the number list under claim 3 and the number list under claim 4 are DIFFERENT lists, printed in two separate ruled boxes, and the association is unambiguous on the page: each box sits directly under the claim that introduces it and above the next claim number, and no caption or footnote crosses between them. Claim 3's box has 37 values running 593 to 3075; claim 4's box has 36 values running 91 to 1679. Only two values, 921 and 1461, occur in both. Claim 3 is introduced as the Infrarot-Spektrum and claim 4 as the Raman-Spektrum, and the two ranges are consistent with that: the Raman list starts at 91 cm-1, well below the usual lower limit of a mid-infrared measurement, and the infrared list carries the 2897 to 3075 cm-1 C-H stretch band that the Raman list does not. That is corroboration, not the basis of the assignment; the assignment is read off the page layout. There is no ambiguity to record and nothing was assumed. COLUMN STRUCTURE: both boxes are four columns wide with a vertical rule between column 2 and column 3 and no header row. Claim 3: 4 columns, 10 rows, 37 values (column 4 short by three). Claim 4: 4 columns, 9 rows, 36 values (full). Both read column-major, confirmed by the values ascending strictly in that order. The extracted text layer flattens both boxes row-major and destroys that order, exactly as correction 3 of the shared briefing warns; the layout here was read off the page image and the digits were then confirmed against the text layer, which matches value for value in both boxes. Both tables were also re-read at 3x magnification to check every digit. The lists are recorded inside the zh and en of claims 3 and 4 as markdown tables, per the briefing, because a table has no representation of its own downstream. DRAWINGS: none. This page carries no chemical structure and no scheme, so the empty drawings array is a finding and not an omission. The two ruled boxes are number tables, not drawings, and are recorded in the claim text as above. ARTEFACTS: the left margin carries the EPO line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55 in small type. They are typesetting furniture, not content, and are not transcribed. The header is the running head 'EP 2 045 236 A1' and the footer is the page number '12'. MODEL: this vision read was produced by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5[1m]).
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
